```{r load-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(shiny)
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(rnaturalearth)

# Read the CSV files in your project folder
global_raw <- read_csv(
  "Brianna/Estimated number of malaria cases 2000-2015.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

europe_raw <- read_csv(
  "Brianna/Estimated number of WHO Europe malaria cases 2000-2015.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Prepare the global data
global_cases <- global_raw %>%
  transmute(
    iso3 = SpatialDimValueCode,
    country = Location,
    year = as.integer(Period),
    cases = as.numeric(FactValueNumeric)
  ) %>%
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2015)

# Prepare the European data
europe_cases <- europe_raw %>%
  transmute(
    iso3 = SpatialDimValueCode,
    country = country,
    year = as.integer(year),
    cases = as.numeric(FactValueNumeric)
  ) %>%
  filter(year >= 2000, year <= 2015)

# Load country borders
world <- ne_countries(
  scale = "medium",
  returnclass = "sf"
) %>%
  mutate(
    iso3 = if_else(iso_a3 == "-99", adm0_a3, iso_a3)
  ) %>%
  select(iso3, name, geometry)

case_palette <- colorNumeric(
  palette = c(
    "#21113D",  # Deep purple: low values
    "#63318E",  # Purple
    "#B536A0",  # Magenta
    "#F15BB5",  # Bright pink
    "#FFD166"   # Warm yellow: high values
  ),
  domain = europe_cases$cases,
  na.color = "#30303A"
)

```


```{r draw-map} 
id="mapfunc01"
europe_iso3 <- c(
  "ALB", "AND", "ARM", "AUT", "AZE", "BLR", "BEL",
  "BIH", "BGR", "HRV", "CYP", "CZE", "DNK", "EST",
  "FIN", "FRA", "GEO", "DEU", "GRC", "HUN", "ISL",
  "IRL", "ISR", "ITA", "KAZ", "KGZ", "LVA", "LTU",
  "LUX", "MLT", "MCO", "MNE", "NLD", "MKD", "NOR",
  "POL", "PRT", "MDA", "ROU", "RUS", "SMR", "SRB",
  "SVK", "SVN", "ESP", "SWE", "CHE", "TJK", "TUR",
  "TKM", "UKR", "GBR", "UZB"
)

draw_malaria_map <- function(selected_year) {

  map_data <- world %>%
    filter(iso3 %in% europe_iso3) %>%
    left_join(
      europe_cases %>%
        filter(year == as.integer(selected_year)),
      by = "iso3"
    ) %>%
    mutate(is_azerbaijan = iso3 == "AZE")

  leaflet(map_data) %>%
    addTiles() %>%
    setView(lng = 35, lat = 48, zoom = 3) %>%
    addPolygons(
      fillColor = ~case_palette(cases),
      fillOpacity = 0.9,
      color = ~ifelse(is_azerbaijan, "#FF3CAC", "#55515F"),
      weight = ~ifelse(is_azerbaijan, 4, 0.8),
      label = ~paste0(
        name,
        ifelse(is_azerbaijan, " ★ FOCUS COUNTRY", ""),
        ": ",
        ifelse(
          is.na(cases),
          "No estimate available",
          format(round(cases), big.mark = ",")
        ),
        " estimated cases"
      ),
      highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
        weight = 4,
        color = "#FFD166",
        bringToFront = TRUE
      )
    ) %>%
    addLabelOnlyMarkers(
      data = sf::st_point_on_surface(
        map_data %>% filter(is_azerbaijan)
      ),
      label = ~"AZERBAIJAN",
      labelOptions = labelOptions(
        noHide = TRUE,
        direction = "top",
        textOnly = TRUE,
        style = list(
          "color" = "#FF3CAC",
          "font-weight" = "bold",
          "font-size" = "12px",
          "text-shadow" = "0 0 5px #000000"
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    addLegend(
      position = "bottomright",
      pal = case_palette,
      values = europe_cases$cases,
      title = "Estimated cases",
      na.label = "No estimate"
    ) %>%
    addControl(
      paste0(
        "<strong style='color:#FF3CAC'>WHO EUROPE</strong>",
        "<br>Year: ", selected_year,
        "<br><span style='color:#FFD166'>●</span> ",
        "Azerbaijan highlighted"
      ),
      position = "topleft"
    )
}
```

```{r run-maps, echo=FALSE}
library(bslib)
library(plotly)

ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = bs_theme(
    bootswatch = "cyborg",
    bg = "#050509",
    fg = "#F5F5F7",
    primary = "#FF3CAC",
    secondary = "#7B2CBF"
  ),

  tags$head(tags$style(HTML("
    body { background: #050509; }
    .dashboard-title {
      color: #FF3CAC;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
    }
    .panel-card {
      background: #111118;
      border: 1px solid #30243F;
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .nav-tabs > li.active > a,
    .nav-tabs > li.active > a:hover {
      background: #21113D !important;
      color: #FF3CAC !important;
      border-color: #63318E !important;
    }
    .nav-tabs > li > a { color: #D9CDE8; }
    .control-label { color: #F5F5F7; }
  "))),

  div(
    class = "panel-card",
    h2(
      class = "dashboard-title",
      "MALARIA ERADICATION EXPLORER"
    ),
    p(
      "WHO European Region | 2000–2015",
      style = "color:#B9B1C9;"
    ),
    sliderInput(
      "year", "Explore the year:",
      min = 2000, max = 2015,
      value = 2000, step = 1, sep = "",
      animate = animationOptions(
        interval = 1500, loop = TRUE
      )
    )
  ),

  fluidRow(
    column(
      8,
      div(
        class = "panel-card",
        h4("European malaria hotspot"),
        leafletOutput("malaria_map", height = "610px")
      )
    ),

    column(
      4,
      div(
        class = "panel-card",
        tabsetPanel(
          tabPanel(
            "Azerbaijan",
            br(),
            uiOutput("azerbaijan_summary")
          ),
          tabPanel(
            "Trend",
            br(),
            plotlyOutput("az_trend", height = "420px")
          ),
          tabPanel(
            "Timeline",
            br(),
            h4("Key milestones"),
            p(
              strong("2012"),
              br(),
              "Azerbaijan reported zero indigenous cases."
            ),
            p(
              strong("2015"),
              br(),
              "The WHO European Region reached zero indigenous malaria cases."
            ),
            p(
              strong("2023"),
              br(),
              "Azerbaijan was certified malaria-free by WHO."
            ),
            p(
              style = "color:#B9B1C9;font-size:12px;",
              "Milestones describe indigenous transmission, ",
              "not the estimated-case shading on the map."
            )
          )
        )
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  output$malaria_map <- renderLeaflet({
    make_map_data <- function(selected_year) {
  world %>%
    filter(iso3 %in% europe_iso3) %>%
    left_join(
      europe_cases %>% filter(year == as.integer(selected_year)),
      by = "iso3"
    ) %>%
    mutate(is_azerbaijan = iso3 == "AZE")
}
    draw_malaria_map(input$year)
  })

  
observeEvent(input$year, {
  map_data <- make_map_data(as.integer(input$year))

  leafletProxy("malaria_map", data = map_data) %>%
    clearGroup("country-polygons") %>%
    addPolygons(
      group = "country-polygons",
      layerId = ~iso3,
      fillColor = ~case_palette(cases),
      fillOpacity = 0.9,
      color = ~ifelse(is_azerbaijan, "#FF3CAC", "#55515F"),
      weight = ~ifelse(is_azerbaijan, 3, 0.8),
      label = ~paste0(
        name,
        ifelse(is_azerbaijan, " ★ FOCUS COUNTRY", ""),
        ": ",
        ifelse(
          is.na(cases),
          "No estimate available",
          format(round(cases), big.mark = ",")
        ),
        " estimated cases"
      ),
      highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
        weight = 3,
        color = "#FFD166",
        bringToFront = TRUE
      )
    )
}, ignoreInit = TRUE)

  output$azerbaijan_summary <- renderUI({
    az <- europe_cases %>%
      filter(
        iso3 == "AZE",
        year == as.integer(input$year)
      )

    if (nrow(az) == 0 || is.na(az$cases[1])) {
      return(
        div(
          h3("Azerbaijan"),
          p("No estimate available for this year.")
        )
      )
    }

    div(
      h4("AZERBAIJAN", style = "color:#FF3CAC;"),
      h2(
        format(round(az$cases[1]), big.mark = ","),
        style = "color:#FFD166;"
      ),
      p("Estimated malaria cases"),
      p(paste("Selected year:", input$year))
    )
  })

  output$az_trend <- renderPlotly({

    az <- europe_cases %>%
      filter(iso3 == "AZE") %>%
      arrange(year)

    if (nrow(az) == 0) {
      return(
        plot_ly() %>%
          layout(
            title = "No Azerbaijan time-series data found",
            paper_bgcolor = "#111118",
            plot_bgcolor = "#111118",
            font = list(color = "#F5F5F7")
          )
      )
    }

    plot_ly(
      data = az,
      x = ~year,
      y = ~cases,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      line = list(color = "#FF3CAC", width = 3),
      marker = list(color = "#FFD166", size = 7),
      hovertemplate = paste(
        "Year: %{x}",
        "<br>Estimated cases: %{y:,.0f}",
        "<extra></extra>"
      )
    ) %>%
      layout(
        title = "Azerbaijan: estimated cases",
        paper_bgcolor = "#111118",
        plot_bgcolor = "#111118",
        font = list(color = "#F5F5F7"),
        xaxis = list(
          title = "Year",
          gridcolor = "#30243F"
        ),
        yaxis = list(
          title = "Estimated cases",
          gridcolor = "#30243F"
        ),
        margin = list(l = 55, r = 15, t = 55, b = 45)
      )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
